items.title: Meta's Muse AI teams up with Shopify, lifting its stock
items.summary: Meta Platforms' (META) new AI agent Muse is teaming up with Shopify (SHOP) to help and enable consumers to complete online purchases. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley breaks down the value this represents for Meta.

items.title: The Magnificent 7 are back: Meta’s AI bet leads the charge
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor and host of Sozzi Unleashed, Brian Sozzi, tees up the stories making waves across the markets. The Magnificent 7 are back in focus as megacap tech stocks help push markets higher, with Meta (META) leading the charge after its new Muse AI agent gained momentum and climbed to the top spot on Apple's (AAPL) App Store.

items.title: VGT Holders Bought ‘Tech’ and Own No Google, Meta, or Amazon: The Sector Rule That Decides What’s Inside
items.summary: VGT promises tech exposure, but a classification rule buried in the index methodology quietly excludes three of the biggest names most investors assume they are buying. Knowing which ones changes how your whole portfolio actually fits together.

items.title: Google Is Taking Its AI Chips Outside the Cloud. Nvidia Just Got a New Sovereign-AI Rival
items.summary: Google is testing whether its custom AI chips can become national infrastructure instead of remaining mostly a cloud advantage. A September 22 report from Seoul Economic Daily said Google met South Korean officials on September 9 to discuss supplying tensor processing units for the country’s sovereign-AI buildout. items.title: $223 Billion Back To Shareholders: Inside The MSFT Machine
items.summary: Microsoft handed shareholders one of the largest cash returns in market history, but what did that money actually buy for the owners who held on.

items.title: Micron vs. SanDisk: Comparing Two Red-Hot AI Memory Stocks
items.summary: Memory stocks have reemerged as the biggest beneficiaries of the AI infrastructure boom, with Micron Technology (MU) and SanDisk (SNDK) delivering extraordinary rallies.

items.title: Can This Number Push IBM Stock Higher?
items.summary: The number worth watching at International Business Machines (IBM) is its annual recurring revenue. It kept growing through a weak quarter. You may expect the story here to be the missed second quarter or the falling stock. It is not. So how big is this recurring revenue business, and how fast is it growing.

items.title: Google Appeals $425M Privacy Verdict
items.summary: A jury determined after trial that Google wrongly gathered analytics information even after mobile users attempted to block data collection.
